result.summary: The image shows a large, multi-lane intersection designed exclusively for high-volume vehicular traffic with a complete absence of pedestrian infrastructure. There are no visible sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or pedestrian signals, creating a highly hostile environment for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without any mid-point refuge, significantly increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Facilities
hazards.description: The total absence of sidewalks and marked crossings forces pedestrians into the roadway with no designated safe space.

interventions.title: Install Marked Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Provide high-visibility crosswalks and dedicated signal phases to allow pedestrians to cross safely.

interventions.title: Construct Sidewalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Establish a continuous, ADA-compliant pedestrian network to separate people from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the roadway to reduce crossing distance and exposure.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane intersection with high-speed vehicle characteristics and a long pedestrian crossing distance. While basic infrastructure like a marked crosswalk and curb ramps are present, the scale of the roadway and the presence of large commercial vehicles create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The excessive width of the roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to moving traffic without a refuge.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: The large semi-truck positioned at the crosswalk line can block the view between pedestrians and other approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection at the stop line

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection is characterized by a high-speed, multi-lane design with a dedicated right-turn slip lane that increases pedestrian exposure. While basic infrastructure like traffic signals and faded crosswalks are present, the environment lacks pedestrian refuge islands and features long crossing distances across a wide roadway.

hazards.name: High-speed slip lane
hazards.description: The right-turn slip lane allows vehicles to maintain high speeds while turning, creating a dangerous conflict point for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a long duration without any mid-crossing refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crossing across the foreground roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from large vehicles
hazards.description: Large trucks parked or moving near the intersection can block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image where the semi-truck is located

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace the faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental or ladder-style markings.

interventions.title: Slip Lane Reconstruction
interventions.description: Tighten the turning radius of the slip lane or remove it entirely to slow down turning vehicles and improve sight lines.

result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed arterial road with a complete lack of pedestrian infrastructure, including sidewalks and marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to navigate unpaved shoulders and cross multiple lanes of traffic without any protection or signals.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: Complete absence of sidewalks and marked crosswalks forces pedestrians into the roadway or onto uneven dirt shoulders.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway and at the intersection.

hazards.name: High-Speed Multi-Lane Roadway
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane configuration encourages high vehicle speeds and creates a long, unprotected crossing distance.

hazards.name: Construction Zone Obstructions
hazards.description: Construction equipment and utility work on the right side create physical and visual obstructions for anyone walking along the road.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on both sides of the road to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks and pedestrian-actuated signals to facilitate safe crossing of the wide arterial.
